image_description: A close-up, side-profile photograph of a common iguana (Iguana iguana). The subject is positioned facing left, with its head and upper torso clearly visible against a blurred, dark background. Key features include the prominent subtympanic shield, the dewlap under the chin, the dorsal crest spines along the neck, and textured scales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is consistent with an iguana, appearing robust and somewhat triangular in profile. A distinct fold of skin (dewlap) is visible hanging from the lower jaw/throat area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is clearly visible. It has a round pupil and the iris appears to have yellowish/golden tones, consistent with the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A very distinct, large, circular pale scale is visible on the cheek/jaw area, which is the characteristic subtympanic shield of an iguana.
The visible portion of the torso appears thick and muscular, fitting the 'robust' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The iguana in the image is primarily greyish-brown/tan with some greenish tints, lacking the vibrant bright green or distinct broad black bands described for typical specimens. While color variation exists, it does not strictly match the 'bright green' or 'broad black bands' description provided in the checkpoint.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A clear row of spike-like scales (dorsal crest) is visible running down the back of the neck and onto the upper back.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture is highly detailed, showing fine granular scales on the body and larger, smoother plates on the snout and face.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The limbs are mostly out of frame or obscured by the angle. Only the very top of the shoulder/forelimb area is barely visible; the feet and digits are not visible to verify the count or claws.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in this cropped head-and-shoulders shot.
